msg:
Stick with the highest scoring pairs. I found the brown and red gnomes are a pair, and the green and purple. The brown and red gnomes have a red basket and the green and purple gnomes have a yellow basket.
One pair will collect a high amount of mushrooms e.g if brown gnomes collected high number of mushrooms, the next selection would be a brown or red gnomes. 
Once the number of mushroom starts getting low, swap to the next pair. E.g if been using brown/ red then swap to green/ purple gnome
